title: Tensor Degenerations for Matrix Multiplication
summary: Let ${\mathbb K}$ be an arbitrary field. We study tensor degenerations for square matrix multiplication over the field ${\mathbb K}$, and mainly prove for any integer $n\ge5$ the uniform dyadic estimate \[ \underline{\mathrm R}_{\mathbb K}({\mathsf M}_{2^n}) \le 2^{2n+1}\] which implies that $ω(\mathbb K)\le 2+1/n$, where the border rank $\underline{\mathrm R}_{\mathbb K}(T)$ is the least $r$ for which the scalar extension of $T$ to an algebraic closure of $\mathbb K$ lies in the Zariski closure of the tensors of rank at most $r$, and $ω(\mathbb K)$ is the matrix multiplication exponent over…
